section.content: 为了进一步提高在线翻译时的效率和准确性，从而提高翻译数据库的更新效率，本发明提供了一种机器学习人工智能翻译数据库的更新方法，包括(10)以机器学习方式建立词语库；(20)建立人工智能语音预测模型；(30)将待翻译的语音转换成文字；(40)根据所述词语库和语音预测模型，确定译文文字。本发明能够通过机器学习得到的大数据外文‑中文对照词典，基于6阶深度概率分析方法进行语义和语境的匹配，从而相比现有技术的做法降低了超过40％以上的运算量，在确保翻译准确性的同时提高了翻译效率和更新效率。

In order to further improve the efficiency and accuracy in online translation and thus improve the updating efficiency of a translation database, the invention provides a method for updating a machine learning artificial intelligence translation database, which comprises the following steps of (10) establishing a word library in a machine learning mode; (20) establishing an artificial intelligent voice prediction model; (30) converting the speech to be translated into text; (40) And determining translated text according to the word library and the voice prediction model. According to the invention, the semantic and context matching can be performed based on a 6-order deep probability analysis method through a big data foreign language-Chinese comparison dictionary obtained by machine learning, so that the operand is reduced by more than 40% compared with the method in the prior art, the translation accuracy is ensured, and the translation efficiency and the updating efficiency are improved.

Updating method of machine learning artificial intelligence translation databaseTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of voice control, in particular to a method for updating a machine learning artificial intelligence translation database.

Background

With the development of science and technology and the globalization of economy, online translation communication has been increasingly demanded, both in daily life and in academic field communication. Although simultaneous interpretation, portable machine interpretation devices, etc. have existed, the accuracy of conventional machine interpretation devices and the efficiency of simultaneous interpretation personnel are of great concern in use scenarios involving professional-area meetings or classes, etc. Especially when a certain party is faster, the machine translation is difficult to be qualified, and simultaneous interpretation personnel need to use a reconfirmation mode to reproduce the language which is not kept in charge, so that unsmooth experience is brought to some use scenes.

In order to simultaneously meet the requirements of improving the efficiency and the accuracy of online translation, the Chinese patent application with the application number of CN201710203439.8 discloses a multi-language intelligent pretreatment real-time statistic machine translation system, which comprises the following steps: the device comprises a receiving module, a preprocessing module, a machine translation module and a post-processing module. The receiving module comprises a text language receiving module and a voice recognition result receiving module; the preprocessing module comprises a text preprocessing module and a voice recognition result preprocessing module; the machine translation module is used for learning the translation of the phrases and finding out corresponding translation phrases for the phrases processed by the preprocessing module, and connecting the phrases into complete sentences; and the post-processing module is used for carrying out word punctuation standardization, case and case standardization and format standardization processing on the translation result so that the translation result is more similar to the expression habit of the target language and is output as a final result. However, such a system has limited resolution to the above-mentioned drawbacks of the prior art.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to further improve the efficiency and accuracy in online translation and thus improve the updating efficiency of a translation database, the invention provides a method for updating a machine learning artificial intelligence translation database, which comprises the following steps:

(10) Establishing a word library in a machine learning mode;

(20) Establishing an artificial intelligent voice prediction model;

(30) Converting the voice to be translated into characters;

(40) Determining translated text according to the word library and the voice prediction model;

(50) Correcting the translated text, and updating the word library according to the correction result.

Further, the step (10) includes: and establishing a first association between the foreign language words and words of Chinese meaning corresponding to the foreign language words according to a dictionary by utilizing a machine learning mode, wherein when the Chinese language words are a plurality of translations, the Chinese language words marked by a first sequence position in the dictionary are used as primary Chinese language words, and the Chinese language words at the later sequence position are used as secondary Chinese language words.

Further, the step (20) includes:

(201) The foreign language article is segmented according to the foreign language article to obtain foreign language words, and a second association of the foreign language words, the Chinese translated words and secondary words continuing after the Chinese translated words is established according to the Chinese translated words of the foreign language article;

(202) Indexing the first association and the second association;

further, the step (201) includes: machine learning is performed in an unsupervised learning manner based on foreign language articles.

Further, the step (201) includes: and performing machine learning on the foreign language articles and the translations thereof by adopting a random gradient descent method.

The beneficial effects of the invention include: the large data foreign language-Chinese comparison dictionary obtained by machine learning is used for matching the semantics and the context based on a 6-order deep probability analysis method, so that the operation amount is reduced by more than 40% compared with the method in the prior art, the translation accuracy is ensured, and the translation efficiency and the updating efficiency are improved.
